scope: RGB cross-domain held-out cohort for frozen Ours, RetinexFormer, and SNR-Aware

allowed: degraded/short-exposure RGB input metadata or payloads

snr_aware.scene_selection: scene folder name must occur in test_list.txt
snr_aware.low_frame_order: sorted glob of each scene folder
snr_aware.pairing: each low index is paired with the first filtered GT path; GT is metadata only
snr_aware.rgb_read: numpy payload divided by 255 and channel-permuted [2,1,0]
snr_aware.raw_to_rgb_statement: README says SMID RAW data are transferred to RGB; no exact parameterized conversion recipe is shipped

retinexformer.readme_auxiliary_file: README asks for text_list.txt under data/SMID/SMID_Long_np/
retinexformer.scene_selection: scene folder name must occur in the sibling test_list.txt
retinexformer.low_frame_order: sorted glob of each scene folder
retinexformer.low_frame_cap: none; all low paths are indexed
retinexformer.temporal_window: config says N_frames=5, but test __getitem__ reads one low path [idx:idx+1]
retinexformer.pairing: each low index is paired with the first filtered GT path; GT is metadata only
retinexformer.rgb_read: numpy payload divided by 255 and channel-permuted [2,1,0]
retinexformer.raw_to_rgb_statement: README says process SMID RAW to RGB but does not specify the exact ISP parameters

candidate_low_only_manifest.low_payload_coverage: unavailable on the A6000 host and in the checked TTIE shared artifacts
candidate_low_only_manifest.reference_pair_path_rule_metadata_only: <scene_id>/<first sorted GT path after .ARW and half filters>

blockers: SNR-Aware evaluates only the first 30 low frames per selected scene, while Retinexformer indexes all low frames; the accepted baselines therefore do not define one identical frame cohort.

Retinexformer code requires data/SMID/test_list.txt, while its README instructs placing text_list.txt under data/SMID/SMID_Long_np; the shipped public instructions do not bind these names to one exact file.
The public README statements identify RAW-to-RGB processing but do not ship an exact parameterized ISP recipe, so RGB conversion cannot be independently reproduced from metadata alone.
No SMID_LQ_np payload is present on the checked A6000 host or in TTIE shared artifacts; low coverage, geometry, dtype, and per-file hashes cannot be sealed without obtaining the dataset payload.
